notes.title: Initial freeze. Please be patient. Will work and will be fixed.
notes.content: Due to the high quality of the in-game graphics we are aware of a ‘screen hang’ upon loading the game. It lasts for approximately 1 minute on lower end machines. The screen is actually blank and some people may thing the game has crashed, which is hasn’t.  This is being fixed now and we will have the new master Monday/Tuesday next week.
